en.headline: Causeway Bay Winter Wonderland opens 25 November with elf-themed lights
en.dek: The Hong Kong Tourism Board said the Lee Gardens area will host light shows from 7pm to 10pm and an outdoor bar as part of the expanded WinterFest until 3 January.
body: The Hong Kong Tourism Board said Hong Kong Winter Wonderland in Causeway Bay will open on 25 November, extending the annual WinterFest beyond Central and Tsim Sha Tsui for the first time.

According to the board, the Lee Gardens area will be themed as an elf village inspired by a story of Santa Claus and six elves. Light shows projected on building facades along Lan Fong Road and Pak Sha Road will run from 7pm to 10pm daily until 3 January, depicting elves preparing gifts.

An outdoor bar called Elves’ Night Out will operate on Hysan Avenue from 8pm to 10pm on the opening night and from 5.30pm to 10pm thereafter. A Christmas market and workshops are scheduled from mid-December. Admission to the outdoor installations is free, the board said.

The overall WinterFest, which began on 18 November in Central and Tsim Sha Tsui, runs until 5 January and includes light shows on both sides of Victoria Harbour. Causeway Bay marks the final district to join the programme.

zh.headline: 銅鑼灣冬日仙境25日開幕 精靈主題燈飾亮相利園區
zh.dek: 旅發局表示，利園區將由晚上7時至10時有燈光表演，並設戶外酒吧，作為擴大版冬日巡禮的一部分，至1月3日結束。
body: 香港旅遊發展局表示，銅鑼灣香港冬日仙境將於11月25日開幕，是今年冬日巡禮首次將活動範圍由中環及尖沙咀擴展至銅鑼灣。
旅發局指，利園區將打造成精靈村主題，靈感來自聖誕老人與六位精靈的故事。沿蘭芳道及白沙道的建築物外牆將投影燈光表演，每日晚上7時至10時上演，至1月3日止，內容為精靈準備禮物的情景。
希慎道的「精靈夜出」戶外酒吧開幕當晚由晚上8時至10時營業，其後由下午5時半至晚上10時。聖誕市集及工作坊則安排在12月中旬開始。旅發局表示，戶外裝置免費入場。
整體冬日巡禮於11月18日在中環及尖沙咀展開，至1月5日結束，並包括維港兩岸的燈光表演。銅鑼灣是最後加入的區域。
